tier_ladder.adaptation_note: REVIVED IN PLACE 2026-08-08 — this file carries a RETIRED header, but tier_ladder specifically is NOT dead: it is the stat spine of the Adaptation system (docs/design/adaptation.md, docs/data/unit-types.json 'adaptation'). A rung is (unit_type, tier, variant_index) and 'tier' keys tiers[] below, so NO second HP/DPS ladder exists anywhere. Array order is rung order — the same convention Scripts/sim/decisions.py:77-78 already reads off this table. The 'bannerman' row is the CAPTAIN rung, reused rather than replaced: its aura trait and its rare flag already fit, and its 'item/event reward only, not a purchasable tier' clause is what makes the captain the one rung the shop cannot sell. MEASURED 2026-08-08 (Scripts/sim/sweep.py over docs/data/scenarios/adaptation-ladder.json, 120 spearmen vs brood_elite): freed 6.75s -> militia 2.70s -> veteran 1.42s, i.e. 60.0% and 47.4% separation against a 5.4% floor; bannerman measures 2.08s, SLOWER than veteran, because it is 160/35 against veteran's 190/45 and the point-target model has no aura primitive. DO NOT raise bannerman's stats to make that table monotonic — it is a support unit, not a fourth power rung, and these four rows are guarded by Scripts/sim/drift_check.py.
tier_ladder.note: The Liberated ladder from CLASSES.md §1. RECRUIT adds bodies at FREED (weak). PROMOTE (depth) spends Embers to move units up a tier — adds NO upkeep, so it is the upkeep-efficient path. MILITIA = the gate-1 prototype unit (130 HP / 30 DPS) and the balance anchor. SUPERSEDED 2026-07-31: the sentence that stood here — 'All tiers are RUN-SCOPED (reset each run — roguelike purity, GDD §3)' — is retired. Tiers are NOT run-scoped; the army persists across runs, and the GDD §3 citation now points at text that says the opposite. See docs/design/DIRECTION-2026-07-31.md.

items.acquisition_note: SUPERSEDED 2026-07-31 (D4/D12) — the '3 offered per growth site; take 1' clause in the note below is dead: growth sites are deleted and these 6 items are the SHOP's opening stock, bought with gold. Original clause kept in place, not rewritten. ADAPTATION, 2026-08-08: the shop also stocks Adaptation rungs, and they are deliberately NOT enumerated in catalog[] — a rung is derived from docs/data/unit-types.json 'adaptation.ladders[].rungs[]', and copying them here would create a second source of truth for the same ladder. The stock rule needs no catalog and no number: the shop offers rungs on branches the player's pick did not grant. Price is an explicit null in unit-types.json (O8), blocked on O4 — gold's drop rate and sources are undecided (GDD.md Q26). The captain rung ('bannerman' in tier_ladder above) is not purchasable at all.
items.note: Stacking run-items — the sanctioned 'Loot v0' (RTS-VERTICAL-SLICE §4), NOT the real deferred loot system (GDD §8). Each item feeds hero OR retinue OR the economy — the GDD twist that loot serves the army, not just the hero. 3 offered per growth site; take 1.
